message:
Let an agent assess every criterion, with each criterion corrected (1.15.0) (#67)

* Let the assessor decide every result, and rework R05 around a smoke kit (1.15.0)

Add Deciding Without The Maintainer to Assessment: a fixed order of
questions, a closed list of reasons that make a deviation intended, and
a floor that intent never excuses. Rework R05 around a documented smoke
kit an agent can run, with a Pass/Partial/Fail table, and D03 around a
runnable health command. Reassess this repository; no result changes.
See decision 0015.
